name: did-r
description: Baseline: R did 2.5.1 with DRDID 1.3.0 via rpy2 for the task's balanced csdid201-rule workloads (did's rules); DRDID estimators with the task's trimming level behind did's own overlap and conditioning checks; the universal base's reference cells and e = -1 dropped; influence-function aggregates; with multipliers, the same estimation runs did's multiplier bootstrap, aggte the aggregations' and mboot the pre/post averages'.
